media.title: Alfred Zeisler — autograph card, 1932
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait of the film director Alfred Zeisler from a 1932 autograph card.
media.publicCaption: Alfred Zeisler on an autograph card dated 1932. Zeisler directed Schuß im Morgengrauen (1932), for which Kaper and Jurmann wrote the music.
media.publicCreditLine: Wikimedia Commons, released to the public domain by the uploader.
media.rightsNote: The Wikimedia Commons uploader, user Azeisler, declares the file own work and releases it into the public domain worldwide. The card itself is a 1932 studio autograph card, so the release rests on the uploader’s assertion of ownership rather than on an expiry of term.

works.title: Schuß im Morgengrauen
works.publicNote: Bronisław Kaper is attributed as composer with probable certainty. The attribution rests on IMDb; the contextual and language-version sources linked here do not independently confirm the music credit.
